eventObjectSchema.title: MouseEvent
eventObjectSchema.description: Events fired by the relevant mouse/touch interaction.

altKey.description: True if the 'alt' key was held down when the event was fired.

button.description: The button number that was pressed when the event was fired.

buttons.description: The buttons being depressed when the event was fired.

clientX.description: The X coordinate in local coordinates.

clientY.description: The Y coordinate in local coordinates.

ctrlKey.description: True if the 'ctrl' key was held down when the event was fired.

metaKey.description: True if the 'meta' key was held down when the event was fired.

pageX.description: The X coordinate relative to the whole document.

pageY.description: The Y coordinate relative to the whole document.

screenX.description: The X coordinate in global (screen) coordinates.

screenY.description: The Y coordinate in global (screen) coordinates.

shiftKey.description: True if the 'shift' key was held down when the event was fired.

eventObjectSchema.description: Events fired by the relevant pointer interaction

pointerId.description: A unique identifier for the pointer causing the event.

width.description: The width (magnitude on the X axis), in CSS pixels, of the contact geometry of the pointer.

height.description: The height (magnitude on the Y axis), in CSS pixels, of the contact geometry of the pointer.

pressure.description: The normalized pressure of the pointer input in the range of 0 to 1, where 0 and 1 represent the minimum and maximum pressure the hardware is capable of detecting, respectively.

tangentialPressure.description: The normalized tangential pressure of the pointer input (also known as barrel pressure or cylinder stress) in the range -1 to 1, where 0 is the neutral position of the control.

tiltX.description: The plane angle (in degrees, in the range of -90 to 90) between the Y-Z plane and the plane container both the pointer (e.g. pen stylus) axis and the Y axis.

tiltY.description: The plane angle (in degrees, in the range of -90 to 90) between the X-Z plane and the plane containing both the pointer (e.g. pen stylus) axis and the X axis.

twist.description: The clockwise rotation of the pointer (e.g. pen stylus) around its major axis in degrees, with a value in the range 0 to 359.

pointerType.description: Indicates the device type that caused the event (mouse, pen, touch, etc).

isPrimary.description: Indicates if the pointer represents the primary pointer of this pointer type.

eventObjectSchema.title: KeyEvent
eventObjectSchema.description: Events fired by the relevant keyboard interaction.

altKey.description: True if the 'alt' key was held down when the event was fired.

ctrlKey.description: True if the 'ctrl' key was held down when the event was fired.

key.description: The value of the key interacted with in this event.

locale.description: The locale of the keyboard in use on the device. May be blank.

location.description: The location of the key interacted with on the keyboard.

metaKey.description: True if the 'meta' key was held down when the event was fired.

repeat.description: True if the key is being held down such that it automatically repeats.

shiftKey.description: True if the 'shift' key was held down when the event was fired.

eventObjectSchema.title: CompositionEvent
eventObjectSchema.description: Events that occur due to the user indirectly entering text.

data.description: The characters generated by the composition event.

eventObjectSchema.title: TouchEvent
eventObjectSchema.description: Events fired upon relevant touch actions.

altKey.description: True if the 'alt' key was held down when the event was fired.

ctrlKey.description: True if the 'ctrl' key was held down when the event was fired.

metaKey.description: True if the 'meta' key was held down when the event was fired.

shiftKey.description: True if the 'shift' key was held down when the event was fired.

eventObjectSchema.title: WheelEvent
eventObjectSchema.description: Event fired upon mouse wheel interaction.

deltaMode.description: 0 (pixels), 1 (lines), or 2 (pages) to represent the units of the delta* values.

deltaZ.description: The scroll amount on the z-axis.
